messages:
nora: Heads-up — finance reconciliation found ~29 invoices where Stripe tax amounts differ from NetSuite by jurisdiction code. Clustered 2026-06-12 01:10-01:40 UTC. Putting it here so ops/product/tax can triage.

ben: Any P0 customers affected? Quick summary of delta amount?

nora: No P0s. Total tax delta ~USD 1,240 spread across 29 invoices. Sample: stripe invoice in_YY12 shows tax 12.34 USD, NS shows 10.00 USD. Stripe tags jurisdiction 'GB-VAT', NetSuite recorded 'UK' generic code -> different rate applied.

ops-bot: [auto] webhook-delivery anomaly count=29 window=2026-06-12T01:05..2026-06-12T01:45 avg_delay=95s

tara: Sounds like the tax-enrichment service emits normalized jurisdiction codes. Did we recently change the mapping table? I recall a PR to map legacy codes to new ISO keys.

nora: Yep — tax-service v2.1.0 deployed last night. Logs show enrichment ran but produced `jurisdiction_code: GB-VAT` for a subset and `jurisdiction: UK` for older invoices. The NS-sync job maps jurisdiction -> NS tax_code via a lookup that only knows about `UK` not `GB-VAT`, so fallback applied a default (lower) rate.

tax-bot: [auto] deploy tax-service@v2.1.0 by @tara at 2026-06-12T00:58:43Z changed: mapping_table=iso_update_2026

ben: Can we confirm whether Stripe's tax was computed at charge-time or via an external tax provider? If Stripe shows the higher tax, it's authoritative for customer charge. We should update NetSuite to match.

nora: Stripe computed tax via external provider (taxjar) and recorded `jurisdiction=GB-VAT`. Our pipeline enrichment overwrote/normalized to `UK` sometimes due to a fallback path in the new mapper.

ops-bot: [auto] suppressed webhook payloads count=12 path=s3://redwood-prod/webhooks/suppressed/2026-06-12/ reason="enrichment_missing_key"

tara: Root cause: the mapping table update removed a legacy key alias that some older invoices still included; mapper then fell back to a generic region label for those payloads. Fix: add alias mapping for 'GB-VAT' -> 'GB:VAT' in mapping table and deploy hotfix. Also add a stricter validation so enrichment fails-fast rather than writing ambiguous `country` only.

nora: Finance asks for a repro list and a safe replay to patch NS records. We should not re-bill customers — only update NetSuite tax lines to reflect the charged tax. Need accounting sign-off for retro updates.

ben: I'll prepare a CSV of affected invoices + stripe_tax + ns_tax + delta and attach for approval. Also include sample event payloads.

finance-bot: [auto] approval-request total_invoices=29 total_delta=1240 requested_by=ben policy=ns_reconcile_retrospective

ops-bot: [auto] mapping-hotfix PR opened https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/7122 by tara (add alias GB-VAT)

tara: Hotfix deployed to canary, smoke passed. Will promote to prod after banking window check.

nora: Meanwhile, can we run a dry-run replay that patches NS via a conservative path: create tax-adjustment memos when invoice is closed, otherwise update invoice tax line. Tool: `tools/replay_tax_fix.py --ids-file ids.csv --dry-run --annotate=taxfix_2026_06_12`

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job queued job_id=taxfix_2026_dry queued_by=nora eta=2026-06-12T03:15:00Z

ben: Dry-run results posted: 29 entries -> 21 would update invoice tax line, 8 would create credit memos (closed invoices). CSV saved at s3://redwood-prod/replay/taxfix_2026_06_12/dryrun.csv

finance-bot: [auto] finance-review required for 8 memos; automatic update allowed for 21 open invoices per accounting policy.

nora: Accounting okayed auto-updates for open invoices and manual review for memos > $100. Two memos exceed $100, rest auto-approved.

ops-bot: [auto] mapping-hotfix promoted to prod by tara at 2026-06-12T03:40:12Z

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job started job_id=taxfix_2026_real status=running

nora: Running real replay now with `--idempotency=tax_event_id` and audit annotations. Will stream NetSuite apply confirmations to s3 artifact.

billing-bot: [auto] replay-job completed job_id=taxfix_2026_real applied_updates=21 memos_created=8 memos_over_100=2 failures=0 duration=00:12:38 artifacts=s3://redwood-prod/replay/taxfix_2026_06_12/applies.csv

ben: Attached applies.csv and accounting noted the two large memos will be reviewed manually; small memos created as per policy. Finance confirmed totals now match Stripe.

tara: Follow-ups: (1) add unit test to mapping loader to include aliases, (2) add a validation that emits `mapping_mismatch` metric if enrichment returns country-only, (3) run a one-week audit comparing stripe_tax vs ns_tax daily. I'll open PRs.

nora: Support note: We'll only notify customers if their invoice balance changed after memo application. For the two >$100 memos accounting will draft comms.

support: I'll prepare message templates and await accounting language.

finance-bot: [auto] reconcile-complete reconcile_id=rec_taxfix_2026_06_12 status=success

ben: Thanks all. I'll write the incident blurb for the monthly billing postmortem and link artifacts. Closing once PM reviews. :white_check_mark:
